task1.title: Home tasks split by gender
task1.prompt: The first chart shows the percentage of women and men in a country involved in some kinds of home tasks (cooking, cleaning, pet caring and repairing the house). The second chart shows the amount of time each gender spent on each task per day.

chartDesc.title: Percentage of males and females who do housework

visuals.caption: Percentage of males and females who do housework
Time spent on each task per day

chartDesc.overview: Females show higher involvement and spend more time on cooking and cleaning than males, whereas males are more involved and spend more time on house repairs. Both genders spend equal time and have nearly equal participation in pet care.
unreadable: Bar values do not have printed numeric labels; values must be read off vertical grid lines spaced at intervals of 10.
The second chart lacks a explicit printed title or unit label directly on the graphic (units inferred from prompt).
keyFeatures: In Chart 1, cooking has the highest participation among females at around 82%, compared to 60% of males.
In Chart 1, house repairs is dominated by males (18% participation) compared to females (around 8%).
In Chart 2, females spend the most time on cooking (approx. 85 minutes per day) and cleaning (approx. 68 minutes per day).
In both charts, pet care shows virtually identical participation (~20%) and time spent (20 minutes per day) for both genders.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparison where relevant.
task1.sampleBand5:
The two charts give information about what men and women do at home. One chart shows the percentage of men and women doing housework, and the other shows how much time they spend.

More women do cooking and cleaning than men. A lot of women, like 75%, cook, but only 25% of men do. For cleaning, it’s almost the same. Pet care is more equal, with maybe 55% of women and 45% of men. Repairing the house is done by more men.

Women spend more time cooking. They spend about 80 minutes a day cooking. Men only spend 30 minutes. Cleaning time is also more for women. But men spend more time repairing, maybe 50 minutes, while women only spend 20 minutes. Pet care time is pretty much the same for both.

Overall, women do more cooking and cleaning and spend more time on these. Men do more repairs.

Regarding time spent, women spent an average of 1.5 hours per day on cooking, whereas men only spent 0.5 hours. The time spent on other activities was less than an hour, with men spending slightly more time on house repairs than women. It is clear that women do more cooking.

task1.sampleAnswer:
The bar charts illustrate the gender distribution across various domestic responsibilities in a particular nation, alongside the average daily duration spent on each activity. Overall, it is striking that women are more extensively involved in most household tasks compared to men, with the notable exception of property repairs. Furthermore, the time allocated to these chores mirrors this participation disparity.

In terms of participation, cooking and cleaning are predominantly female activities, with over 80% of women involved in the former and approximately 60% in the latter. In contrast, only about 60% of men engage in cooking, and a mere 40% participate in cleaning. However, the trend is reversed for property maintenance, where men's participation nearly doubles that of women (20% versus 10%). Pet care shows the most gender-neutral distribution, with roughly 25% of both sexes taking part.

Regarding time expenditure, the data shows that women dedicate significantly more minutes to domestic work. Cooking and cleaning combined account for nearly 100 minutes of a woman's day, whereas men spend roughly half that amount. Interestingly, while fewer people repair the house, those who do—mostly men—spend about 20 minutes daily on this task, exceeding the 5 minutes women spend. Pet care, despite equal participation rates, sees women spending nearly 20 minutes compared to men's 15.
task1.uzSampleBand5:
Ikki jadval erkaklar va ayollar uyda nima qilishlari haqida ma'lumot beradi. Birinchi jadvalda erkaklar va ayollarning uy ishlarini bajarish foizi ko'rsatilgan bo'lsa, ikkinchi jadvalda ular qancha vaqt sarflashlari ko'rsatilgan.

Ko'proq ayollar ovqat pishirish va tozalash bilan shug'ullanishadi, erkaklarga nisbatan. Ko'pgina ayollar, taxminan 75% ovqat pishirishadi, lekin erkaklarning faqat 25%i shug'ullanadi. Tozalash bo'yicha ham deyarli shunday. Uy hayvonlariga g'amxo'rlik qilish tengroq, balki 55% ayollar va 45% erkaklar. Uyni ta'mirlash ko'proq erkaklar tomonidan amalga oshiriladi.

Ayollar ovqat pishirishga ko'proq vaqt sarflashadi. Ular kuniga taxminan 80 daqiqa ovqat pishirishga sarflashadi. Erkaklar esa faqat 30 daqiqa sarflashadi. Tozalash vaqti ham ayollar uchun ko'proq. Lekin erkaklar ta'mirlashga ko'proq vaqt sarflashadi, balki 50 daqiqa, ayollar esa faqat 20 daqiqa. Uy hayvonlariga g'amxo'rlik qilish vaqti ikkalasi uchun ham deyarli bir xil.

Umuman olganda, ayollar ko'proq ovqat pishirish va tozalash bilan shug'ullanishadi va bu ishlarga ko'proq vaqt sarflashadi. Erkaklar esa ko'proq ta'mirlash ishlarini bajarishadi.
task1.uzSampleBand6:
Ikkala jadval maʼlumot beradi maʼlum bir mamlakatda turli xil uy ishlariga jalb qilingan erkaklar va ayollar ulushi, shuningdek, har bir ishga kuniga sarflangan oʻrtacha vaqt haqida.

Umuman olganda, ayollar erkaklarga nisbatan ko'proq jalb qilingan uy ishlarining aksariyatida. Biroq, erkaklar uy ta'miri uchun ko'proq vaqt sarflashgan. Shuningdek, ovqat pishirishga sarflangan vaqtda sezilarli farq borga o'xshaydi.

Raqamlarga diqqat bilan qarasak, ayollarning 70 foizi ovqat pishirish bilan shug'ullangan, erkaklarning atigi 30 foizi. Tozalashda ayollarning 60 foizi ishtirok etgan, erkaklar uchun bu ko'rsatkich taxminan 40 foizni tashkil etdi. Uy hayvonlariga g'amxo'rlik qilishda biroz kichikroq farq bor edi, ayollarning 55 foizi va erkaklarning 45 foizi. Aksincha, uy ta'miri bilan erkaklarning 60 foizi va ayollarning 40 foizi shug'ullangan. Sarflangan vaqtga kelsak, ayollar ovqat pishirishga kuniga o'rtacha 1,5 soat sarflashgan, erkaklar esa atigi 0,5 soat. Boshqa faoliyatlarga sarflangan vaqt bir soatdan kamroq bo'lgan, erkaklar uy ta'miriga ayollarga qaraganda biroz ko'proq vaqt sarflashgan. Aniqki, ayollar ko'proq ovqat pishirishadi.
task1.uzSampleBand7:
Diagrammalar ma'lum bir mamlakatda erkaklar va ayollarning uy yumushlari bilan shug'ullanish ulushini ko'rsatadi, shuningdek, har bir vazifaga kuniga o'rtacha qancha vaqt sarflanishini ham aks ettiradi.

Umuman olganda, barcha uy-ro'zg'or ishlarida ayollarning ishtiroki erkaklarnikiga qaraganda yuqori foizni tashkil etadi. Bundan tashqari, ayollar ovqat tayyorlash, tozalash va uy hayvonlariga g'amxo'rlik qilishga ancha ko'p vaqt ajratishgan, erkaklar esa uy ta'mirlashga biroz ko'proq vaqt sarflashgan.

Xususan, ovqat tayyorlash va tozalash bilan shug'ullanadigan ayollarning foizi ancha yuqori bo'lib, mos ravishda 70% va 65% ni tashkil etdi, erkaklarda esa bu ko'rsatkich 45% va 40% edi. Uy hayvonlariga g'amxo'rlik qilishda farq unchalik katta emas, ayollarning 55% va erkaklarning 30% ishtirok etgan. Uy ta'mirlash erkaklarning (35%) ishtiroki ayollarnikidan (25%) biroz oshib ketgan yagona soha edi. Vaqt taqsimotiga ko'ra, ayollar kuniga o'rtacha 1,5 soat ovqat tayyorlashga va bir soatdan sal ko'proq vaqt tozalashga sarflashgan, erkaklar esa bu vazifalarning har biriga taxminan 45 daqiqa sarflashgan. Shuni ta'kidlash joizki, har ikki jins ham uy hayvonlariga g'amxo'rlik qilishga o'xshash vaqt sarflashgan – taxminan 30 daqiqa. Erkaklar, uy ta'mirlashga biroz ko'proq vaqt sarflashgan, o'rtacha taxminan 1 soat, ayollarda esa bu ko'rsatkich 45 daqiqa.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, ayollar nafaqat uy yumushlarida tez-tez ishtirok etishgan, balki ularga ancha ko'p vaqt ajratishgan, bundan faqat erkaklar biroz ko'proq vaqt sarflagan uy ta'mirlash ishlari mustasno.

Umuman olganda, vazifalarni taqsimlashda keskin tafovut mavjud, ayollar uy ishlarida ko'proq ishtirok etadi va erkaklarga qaraganda ancha ko'p vaqt sarflaydi. Tozalash va ovqat tayyorlash asosan ayollar tomonidan amalga oshirilsa, erkaklar uyni ta'mirlash bilan ko'proq shug'ullanishadi.

Birinchi diagrammaga nazar tashlasak, ayollar ovqat tayyorlash va tozalashda mos ravishda 70% va 65% darajasida ishtirok etadilar, erkaklar uchun tegishli ko'rsatkichlar esa ancha past - 25% va 20%. Uy hayvonlariga g'amxo'rlik qilish yanada teng taqsimlangan, ayollarning 55% va erkaklarning 45% ishtirok etadi. Biroq, uyni ta'mirlash asosan erkaklarning sohasi bo'lib, erkaklarning 60% ishtirok etadi, ayollarning esa faqat 10%. Ikkinchi diagramma shuni ko'rsatadiki, ayollar har kuni ovqat tayyorlashga taxminan 120 daqiqa va tozalashga 90 daqiqa sarflaydilar, bu erkaklarning ushbu vazifalarga sarflaydigan 30 daqiqa va 20 daqiqasidan ancha oshib ketadi. Uy hayvonlariga g'amxo'rlik qilishda vaqt taqsimoti yaqinroq, ayollar o'rtacha 40 daqiqa va erkaklar 30 daqiqa sarflaydilar. Erkaklar har kuni uyni ta'mirlashga taxminan 60 daqiqa sarflaydilar, ayollar esa bunga deyarli vaqt ajratmaydilar. Aslida, ayollar uy ishlarining, ayniqsa ovqat tayyorlash va tozalashning nomutanosib yukini o'z zimmalariga oladilar. Ma'lumotlar uy xo'jaligida mehnatning an'anaviy taqsimotini ta'kidlaydi. task2.title: Banning dangerous sports
task2.prompt: Some people think that dangerous sport should be banned while others believe people should have the freedom to choose activities. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
task2.instruction: Discuss both views and give your opinion.
task2.sampleBand5:
Many people like to do sports. Some sports are safe, like running or swimming. But other sports are dangerous, for example, like mountain climbing or racing cars. There are different ideas about these dangerous sports. Some people think they should not be allowed, and other people think that everyone should be able to choose what they want to do.

One idea is that dangerous sports are not good. People can get hurt, sometimes very badly. If someone is hurt, they need doctors and hospitals. This costs a lot of money. Also, if someone dies in a sport, it is very sad for their family and friends. So, some people think it is better to stop these sports so that people do not get hurt or die. This is a way to protect people.

However, other people think that everyone should be able to choose what they want to do. They say that it is their life, and they should be able to take risks if they want to. They enjoy the feeling of doing something exciting and challenging. They think that the government should not tell them what they can and cannot do. Also, they say that if people are careful and follow the rules, they can be safe even in dangerous sports.

In my opinion, it is important to think about both ideas. I think that people should be able to do what they want, but they should also be careful. Maybe there should be some rules to make sure that people are safe, but I do not think dangerous sports should be banned completely. It is important to find a balance between freedom and safety.
task2.sampleBand6:
There is a debate about whether dangerous sports should be banned. Some people believe that the government should prohibit these activities, while others think that individuals should have the right to choose what they do. This essay will discuss both sides of the argument and then give my own opinion.

On the one hand, there are several reasons why dangerous sports might be banned. Firstly, these activities can lead to serious injuries or even death. This puts a strain on healthcare systems, as injured participants require medical attention. Secondly, some argue that participating in dangerous sports is selfish. If someone is seriously injured, they may become a burden on their family and society. Finally, some people might say that these sports encourage reckless behaviour and a disregard for safety.

However, there is also a strong argument for allowing people to participate in dangerous sports. The main point is that individuals should have the freedom to choose their own activities, as long as they are aware of the risks involved. Many people find these sports exciting and challenging, and they believe that the potential rewards outweigh the dangers. Furthermore, banning these sports could lead to a decline in tourism and revenue for some areas. Also, some would argue that it is not the government's role to protect people from themselves; individuals should be responsible for their own decisions.

In conclusion, while I understand the concerns about safety and the burden on healthcare, I believe that people should have the freedom to participate in dangerous sports if they choose to. It is important to make sure people know about the risks, but ultimately, it should be up to them to decide whether or not to take part. A good compromise might be to require participants to have adequate insurance.
task2.sampleBand7:
The question of whether dangerous sports should be prohibited is a contentious one. While some argue for a ban, citing safety concerns, others maintain that individuals should have the autonomy to engage in activities of their choosing. This essay will examine both perspectives before presenting my own opinion.

Advocates for banning dangerous sports often point to the potential for serious injury or even death. Activities such as extreme skiing, rock climbing, and BASE jumping carry inherent risks, and participants may suffer life-altering consequences. The argument is that the state has a responsibility to protect its citizens from harm, even if that harm is self-inflicted. Furthermore, the cost of treating injuries sustained in these activities can place a significant burden on healthcare systems, diverting resources from other areas of need. From this perspective, a ban is seen as a necessary measure to safeguard public health and well-being.

Conversely, proponents of individual freedom argue that people should be free to pursue their passions, regardless of the associated risks. They believe that individuals are best placed to assess the potential dangers and make informed decisions about their own activities. Banning dangerous sports is seen as an infringement on personal liberty and an example of excessive state control. Moreover, these activities often provide significant benefits, such as physical fitness, mental stimulation, and a sense of accomplishment. To deprive individuals of these experiences would be detrimental to their overall quality of life. In addition, some argue that banning these sports would simply drive them underground, making them even more dangerous.

In my opinion, a complete ban on dangerous sports is not the answer. While the risks are undeniable, individuals should have the right to choose their own activities, provided they are fully informed of the potential consequences. A more appropriate approach would be to implement stricter safety regulations, promote responsible participation, and ensure that participants have adequate insurance coverage. This would strike a balance between protecting individuals from harm and respecting their freedom of choice. Ultimately, the decision to engage in a dangerous sport should rest with the individual, but with the support of appropriate safeguards.

On balance, while acknowledging the potential dangers, I believe personal freedom and responsible regulation are preferable to outright prohibition.

The debate surrounding the prohibition of dangerous sports is a complex one, with passionate arguments on both sides. While some argue that the state has a responsibility to protect its citizens from harm, others maintain that individuals should have the autonomy to engage in activities of their choosing, regardless of the inherent risks. This essay will explore both perspectives before offering my own opinion.

Proponents of banning dangerous sports often cite the potential for serious injury or death. Activities such as extreme skiing, BASE jumping, and free climbing carry a significant risk, and accidents can result in devastating consequences for participants and their families. Furthermore, these accidents can place a considerable burden on healthcare systems, requiring extensive and costly treatment. From this perspective, a ban is seen as a precautionary measure designed to safeguard public health and well-being. They might also point to the potential for irresponsible behaviour, where individuals push themselves beyond their limits, further increasing the likelihood of accidents.

Conversely, those who oppose a ban emphasize the importance of personal freedom and the right to make one's own choices. Furthermore, many believe that dangerous sports can provide valuable opportunities for personal growth, helping individuals to develop courage, resilience, and self-reliance. To deny people these experiences would be a form of paternalism, restricting their autonomy and limiting their ability to pursue their passions. Furthermore, it is crucial to raise awareness about the risks involved and to encourage individuals to make informed choices based on a realistic understanding of their own abilities and limitations. A balanced approach, which respects individual autonomy while prioritizing safety, is the most appropriate way to address this complex issue. This entails robust regulation, comprehensive education, and personal accountability.

In conclusion, while the arguments for banning dangerous sports are understandable, the principle of individual freedom should ultimately prevail. By focusing on education, regulation, and personal responsibility, we can mitigate the risks associated with these activities while allowing individuals to pursue their passions and challenge themselves in meaningful ways. task2.sampleAnswer:
The debate surrounding the legality of extreme sports, such as base jumping or big-wave surfing, highlights a tension between public safety and individual liberty. While some advocate for a total ban on such high-risk activities to prevent unnecessary fatalities, others argue that personal autonomy should be paramount. In my opinion, while safety regulations are essential, a complete prohibition would be an overreach of state authority.

Proponents of a ban often cite the significant strain these sports place on public resources. When an accident occurs in remote or hazardous environments, the resulting rescue operations involve expensive equipment and risk the lives of emergency personnel. Furthermore, critics argue that 'thrill-seeking' for entertainment purposes does not justify the potential for lifelong disability or death, which can have devastating effects on the participants' families and society at large. From this perspective, the government has a moral obligation to protect citizens from their own reckless impulses.

On the other hand, many believe that the freedom to choose one's activities is a fundamental human right. They argue that as long as participants are consenting adults who are fully informed of the risks, they should be free to push their physical and mental limits. Moreover, many modern 'dangerous' sports are highly professionalized, with strict training and safety protocols that actually make them statistically safer than many common activities like driving. Banning such sports could also stifle human bravery and the pursuit of excellence, which are qualities that have historically led to progress.

In conclusion, while the risks associated with extreme sports are undeniably high, I believe individuals should retain the right to engage in them. Rather than a ban, the focus should be on ensuring participants are well-trained and that private insurance covers any potential rescue costs. Ultimately, personal freedom is too valuable to be sacrificed for a hypothetical increase in communal safety.

Ba'zi odamlar ularga ruxsat berilmasligi kerak deb hisoblaydi, boshqa odamlar esa har bir kishi o'zi xohlagan narsani tanlash huquqiga ega bo'lishi kerak deb hisoblaydi.

Bir fikr shuki, xavfli sport turlari yaxshi emas. Odamlar jarohat olishi mumkin, ba'zan juda yomon. Agar kimdir jarohat olsa, ularga shifokorlar va kasalxonalar kerak bo'ladi. Bu juda ko'p pulga tushadi. Shuningdek, agar kimdir sportda vafot etsa, bu ularning oilasi va do'stlari uchun juda qayg'uli. Shunday qilib, ba'zi odamlar odamlar jarohatlanmasligi yoki o'lmasligi uchun bu sport turlarini to'xtatish yaxshiroq deb hisoblashadi. Bu odamlarni himoya qilish usuli.

Biroq, boshqa odamlar har bir kishi o'zi xohlagan narsani tanlash huquqiga ega bo'lishi kerak deb hisoblaydi. Ular bu ularning hayoti ekanligini va agar xohlasalar, xavf ostiga qo'yishlari mumkinligini aytishadi. Ular hayajonli narsa qilish tuyg'usidan zavqlanishadi va bu ularga qiyinchilik tug'diradi. Ular hukumat ularga nima qilishlari va nima qilmasliklarini aytmasligi kerak deb hisoblashadi. Shuningdek, ular agar odamlar ehtiyot bo'lishsa va qoidalarga rioya qilishsa, hatto xavfli sport turlarida ham xavfsiz bo'lishlari mumkinligini aytishadi.

Mening fikrimcha, ikkala fikr haqida ham o'ylash muhim. O'ylaymanki, odamlar o'zlari xohlagan narsani qila olishlari kerak, lekin ular ham ehtiyot bo'lishlari kerak. Balki odamlarning xavfsizligini ta'minlash uchun ba'zi qoidalar bo'lishi kerak, lekin men xavfli sport turlarini butunlay taqiqlash kerak deb o'ylamayman. Ozodlik va xavfsizlik o'rtasida muvozanat topish muhim.
